verdict.rationale: Fellow says every conversation is searchable through a full transcript. Its transcripts are diarized and timestamped, and Ask Fellow and the MCP server let users ask questions across past meetings, so the core of searching meeting history is supported. However, nothing documents a single search spanning transcripts, summaries and notes together, or clicking a result to jump to the exact moment in the recording. Missing for 10: an explicit unified search across transcripts, summaries and notes; jump-to-timestamp playback from search results; independent or hands-on corroboration.
